description.value:
You conjure a 20-foot-radius sphere of noxious gas centered on a point you choose within range. The vapor billows around obstacles and heavily obscures its area, persisting for the duration.

At the start of its turn, any creature fully within the cloud must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated with inaction for that turn; creatures that don't breathe or that are immune to poison succeed automatically.

A wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses the cloud after 4 rounds, while a wind of 20 miles per hour or more disperses it after just 1 round.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
